name: scheduler
description: Scheduled Claude Code tasks that run on this machine and outlast the session: /scheduler:tasks turns "every weekday at 7:30, do X" into a task file and a unit in the machine's own scheduler (launchd, systemd user timers or cron), and lists, shows, edits, pauses, resumes, runs now, deletes and explains past runs. Each run is a headless session with its tools named in advance; a run that keeps failing pauses itself and says why.
